fields.name: CopyMapper.Add PostgreSQL COPY batch-registration family
fields.contract: CopyMapper exposes Add extension methods that register a PostgreSQL binary-copy operation on, and return, the supplied DatabaseBatch<TResult>, ShardBatch<TResult>, or ShardSetBatch. The operation family accepts either a model collection or virtual compound keys. Model collections require a reference type with a public parameterless constructor. Key collections support record identity alone or record identity with child, grandchild, or great-grandchild identity; each identity type is comparable and each level is paired with its PgParameterMapAttribute column definition. List<T> overloads are equivalent convenience forms of the corresponding IList<T> operation.
